In particular |B|²=q²(q⁴−12q²+48)/48, and det M=1 gives A²+ρ|B|²=1. With S=diag(√ρ,1), SMS⁻¹ is unitary (determinant one) on 0<q²<12. Using the exact power formula and real S, SP_nS⁻¹ has diagonal cos(nθ) and antisymmetric off-diagonal entries ±(Re B/|B|)sin(nθ); the Gram matrix is the scalar in the output-energy identity. At q²=8 the real coupling vanishes and A=−1/3. At q²=12−δ, A=1−δ/2+δ²/24, sinθ∼√δ, B→√3−3i and C=O(δ). Hence the rescaled diagonal and lower-left entries vanish uniformly in n, and the upper-right coefficients approach (√3−3i)sin(nθ) and √3 sin(nθ). The rank-one norms yield sharp upper bounds, and the integer nearest π/(2θ) gives the lower bounds on the same real vector e₂, without an assumption of phase-density for a fixed q. At δ=0 the nonzero shear grows linearly, including after projection. The real part is taken only after the full recurrence.
